description: Every environment on one page: the backup ages and results of every VM with the backup scripts' metrics. Click a VM for its details.

panels.description: Time since the start of the last full backup that reached the bucket, on the VM where it is oldest. Fulls run on Monday and Friday, so up to 96 h is normal: amber from 108 h, red from 120 h.
panels.title: Oldest full backup

panels.description: Time since the start of the last incremental that reached the bucket, on the VM where it is oldest. There is no incremental on full backup days, so up to 48 h is normal: amber from 54 h, red from 72 h.
panels.title: Oldest incremental

panels.description: Time since the start of the last MySQL Shell backup that reached the bucket, on the VM where it is oldest. It runs daily, so up to 24 h is normal, plus the time the next backup takes until it has uploaded: red from 26 h.
panels.title: Oldest MySQL Shell

panels.description: Time since the last binlog upload that worked, on the VM where it is oldest: how much a lost server could lose. Amber from 30 min, red from 45 min.
panels.title: Oldest binlog backup

panels.description: VMs whose last full, incremental, MySQL Shell or binlog run, or its upload, failed.
panels.title: VMs with failures

panels.description: Closed binlogs not in the bucket yet, on the VM with the most. 0 after every healthy run.
panels.title: Most binlogs waiting

panels.description: The lowest free space on the /backup disk in the last 24 hours, on the VM with the least. The low point comes during the night's backup, before the old local backups are deleted. Red below 10 %, amber below 20 %.

targets.expr: min(100 * (min_over_time(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}[24h]) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}) * on (instance) group_left (exported_instance) group by (instance, exported_instance) ({__name__=~"node_mysql_(backup|incremental_backup|shell_backup|binlog_backup)_status", exported_instance=~".+"}))

panels.title: Lowest /backup free, 24 h

panels.description: One row per VM: the result and age of its last full, incremental and binlog backups. A last run is Failed when the backup or its upload failed. Empty cells: that backup type does not run on the VM. MySQL Shell backups are in their own table. Click a VM for its details.

targets.expr: max by (exported_instance) (100 * (min_over_time(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}[24h]) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}) * on (instance) group_left (exported_instance) group by (instance, exported_instance) ({__name__=~"node_mysql_(backup|incremental_backup|shell_backup|binlog_backup)_status", exported_instance=~".+"}))

panels.title: Every VM

panels.description: The VMs with MySQL Shell backups: the result and age of the last one, and their /backup free space. Last result is Failed when the dump or its upload failed. It runs daily, so up to 24 h is normal, plus the time the next backup takes until it has uploaded: red from 26 h. Click a VM for its details.

targets.expr: max by (exported_instance) (100 * (min_over_time(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}[24h]) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}) * on (instance) group_left (exported_instance) group by (instance, exported_instance) ({__name__=~"node_mysql_(backup|incremental_backup|shell_backup|binlog_backup)_status", exported_instance=~".+"})) and on (exported_instance) node_mysql_shell_backup_status{exported_instance=~".+"}
